text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — elevated 5xx rate from api-gateway (mTLS) in eu-west-1. Automated alert: TLS handshake failures spike at 1759991200, source=gateway-edge, severity=high

alex.h: On it. seeing lots of 502/525 upstream errors and `SSL handshake failed` in gateway logs.

nina.k: same. dig into logs now, putting snippets here.

mike_r: tagging infra-bot to check recent cert rotations and CA publish jobs @infra-bot

infra-bot: Noted. CA rotation job `ca-rotation/2026-11-02` completed at 1759987600 UTC. New CRL/OCSP DP set to `https://internal-s3.redwood/cert-crl/ca-v2.crl` (non-public).

alex.h: that stands out — edge nodes need to fetch CRL/OCSP. Are they failing to reach that endpoint?

nina.k: here's an example TLS log from edge1: 
```
[2026-11-03T03:00:41Z] gw[edge1]: TLSv1.3 handshake failed: cert_verify_failed: CRL check failed: unable to get CRL
[2026-11-03T03:00:41Z] gw[edge1]: client_cn=acct-123, client_ip=10.4.5.6, result=502
```

mike_r: run quick `openssl s_client -connect internal-s3.redwood:443 -status` from an edge node?

tara: ran it from eu-west-1 edge, gets timeout/connection refused. `curl` to the same URL also times out.

alex.h: so new CA points to an internal-only CRL endpoint that edge nodes can't reach. That would cause client certs to be treated as revoked/unverified -> 5xx.

support-bot: Customer impact estimate: affected routes are mTLS-protected endpoints for enterprise tenants ondedicated gateways. Pager shows ~18% 5xx for enterprise routes in eu-west-1 over the last 10m.

nina.k: quick mitigation options:
- revert to previous CA bundle that uses public CRL/OCSP endpoint
- disable CRL/OCSP checking on gateway temporarily (riskier)
- proxy CRL DP through a public fetcher/cache (fast deploy?)

alex.h: prefer revert if possible. mike, can you roll back CA bundle on control plane? Need rollback in config and re-propagation to gateways.

mike_r: I can push a rollback to staging now, but need sign-off for production. Rolling manual change via `rctl certs apply --bundle ca-bundle-v1` will update config. Propagation should be ~2-3 min after restart of gateway agent.

tara: note — for immediate short-term we can flip gateway policy to accept cached OCSP (trust_staple=true) for 15m window. That avoids restart but still lets some bad certs slip.

alex.h: okay do both in parallel: tara, flip cached-ocsp accept on gateway (non-disruptive). mike, prepare rollout plan to restore ca-bundle-v1 and restart agent in canary set first (edge-canary-01/02). After validation, roll the rest.

nina.k: commands I'm going to run on edge-canary-01:
```
# enable cached OCSP accept
redwood-gwctl set --id=edge-canary-01 --tls.accept_cached_ocsp=true
# watch logs
tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/gw.log | grep "CRL"
```

mike_r: prepping rollback PR now: `git pr create -B prod -t "revert: ca-bundle-v2 -> ca-bundle-v1 (CRL DP unreachable)"` then `rctl apply -f rollback-ca.yml`

infra-bot: warning — cluster-wide restart will briefly disrupt long-lived streaming calls. Canary only for now.

alex.h: understood. canary deploy now. @tara can you confirm 5xx rate on canary after the cached-ocsp flip?

tara: flipped cached-ocsp on edge-canary-01, watching metrics... 2m in the error rate dropped from 18% -> 4% on canary routes. :thumbsup:

nina.k: logs on canary show CRL fetch still failing but gateway accepts cached OCSP staple and proceeds.

mike_r: rollback PR merged, applying to canary group. Running `rctl rollout --group canary --service gateway --restart-agents` now.

support-bot: Noted: opened support ticket SR-8942 for affected customers and sent initial notice to enterprise contacts in eu-west-1.

alex.h: canary validated: latency stable, errors down. Starting progressive rollout to remaining nodes with 5m pause per wave. Keeping cached-ocsp=on until propagation completes.

mike_r: rollout done, propagation completed at 1759991700. Restarted agents across all gateways in eu-west-1.

nina.k: endpoint error rate back to baseline (~0.5%). No more CRL errors in logs.

infra-bot: CA job updated: we will replace CRL DP with a publicly accessible proxied URL and add healthcheck to rotation pipeline to ensure edge reachability before cutover. New job created: `ca-rotation/2026-11-03-hotfix`.

alex.h: follow-ups:
- postmortem assigned to @nina.k (owner)
- update runbook: add CRL DP reachability check and fallback behavior
- notify customers in SR-8942 with root cause and mitigation timeline

nina.k: taking postmortem. I will include timeline, impact numbers, and the mitigation steps + the PRs we merged.

mike_r: one more: re-enable strict CRL enforcement only after CRL DP healthcheck passes from multiple edge locations.

alex.h: ok thanks everyone. good quick ops. handing off to night oncall @mike_r for monitoring. If anything regresses ping on this thread. :eyes:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Severity: high -> mitigated. Created incident ticket INC-2026-1143 and linked postmortem placeholder.
